text: いけると　おもったのに

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: いけると　おもった
patterns.explanation: と before おもう shows what was thought. いけると おもった = 'I thought I could do it'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end means 'even though', said with disappointment that things went the other way. おもったのに = 'and I thought so, too...'
